macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks steady-to-lower as markets await inflation data, with futures still supported by AI earnings
items.summary: Global equities were mixed in early Wednesday trading, while U.S. stock futures were modestly higher ahead of the latest CPI report. Reuters said the AI trade got a boost from strong after-market results at CoreWeave, even as some major indexes had recently pulled back from record levels.

items.title: U.S. major indexes recently slipped after hitting record highs
items.summary: NBC News reported that the Dow and S&P 500 had hit record highs earlier, but recent sessions turned weaker as the Fed kept rates unchanged and investors reassessed inflation and growth risks. CNN also showed the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all modestly lower intraday on Wednesday.

items.title: Fed leaves rates unchanged as policymakers await more inflation evidence
items.summary: The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady for the fifth meeting this year, according to NBC News, with inflation concerns still shaping the policy outlook. Markets are now focused on the upcoming CPI report for clues about the Fed’s next move.

items.title: U.S. inflation report is the key macro event of the day
items.summary: Multiple market updates said investors were positioning for the U.S. Consumer Price Index release, which is expected to guide expectations for the Fed’s next policy decision. Reuters noted that economists expected July CPI to rise 0.1% month over month and 3.4% year over year.

items.title: Weak labor-market signals continue to shape recession and rate-cut debate
items.summary: NBC News and CNN highlighted a sharp labor-market reversal, including a reported loss of 23,000 jobs in July, while MarketWatch cited ADP data showing only 44,000 private-sector jobs added in July. Those figures reinforced the view that hiring is soft even as unemployment-related claims remain low.

items.title: CoreWeave and Super Micro earnings help fuel AI-related buying
items.summary: Reuters reported that strong earnings from CoreWeave helped lift risk appetite and supported AI-linked stocks ahead of the CPI release. A separate AFP report said strong results from CoreWeave and Super Micro Computer eased some concerns about the sustainability of the AI investment boom.
items.source: Reuters via AOL / AFP via BSS News

items.title: Meta falls in extended trading after raising 2026 capex outlook
items.summary: NBC News reported that Meta shares fell about 4% in extended trading after the company said 2026 capital expenditures would be higher than previously estimated. Investors appeared to react to the implication of heavier AI and infrastructure spending.

items.title: Oil prices firm as traders weigh geopolitics and inflation
items.summary: Reuters said oil prices were steady to higher as talks to end the Iran war stalled, adding another inflation risk factor for markets ahead of the CPI report. BSS News reported WTI near $83.78 and Brent near $89.40, while Reuters cited modest gains and a firmer U.S. dollar.

items.title: Asian and European markets mixed as investors await U.S. data
items.summary: Reuters reported that Asian equities were mixed and European stocks were slightly higher, with the STOXX 600 up about 0.2% and major European benchmarks up 0.1% to 0.4%. In Asia, gains in tech and semiconductors supported some markets, while Hong Kong lagged.
items.source: Reuters via AOL / EconoTimes / BSS News

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and XRP slip while Dogecoin and Ethereum edge higher
items.summary: Bitcoin was down roughly 0.4% to 1% over the past 24 hours in multiple market trackers, while Ethereum, XRP, Solana, and Dogecoin posted small gains or mixed moves. Market-wide price action remained cautious ahead of macro and regulatory developments.

items.title: Bitcoin trades near $63K as the crypto market consolidates
items.summary: SoSoValue data showed Bitcoin down 0.30% and Ethereum up 0.44%, with most major sectors moving in narrow ranges. The report also highlighted stronger performance in CeFi, Layer1, and meme coins, including Binance Coin, Dogecoin, and Trust Wallet.

items.title: Russia moves toward restricted retail crypto trading on regulated exchanges
items.summary: The Bank of Russia proposed allowing retail trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT on regulated exchanges starting September 1, while keeping strict limits in place. This marks a notable shift from Russia’s previous more restrictive stance on crypto.

items.title: South Korea lowers its crypto Travel Rule threshold
items.summary: Cointelegraph reported that South Korea has dropped the Travel Rule threshold for crypto transfers, signaling a tougher compliance regime for smaller transactions. The move adds to the region’s active regulatory tightening around digital assets.

items.title: SEC reportedly considering a token-sale safe harbor framework
items.summary: A crypto news roundup said the SEC appears ready to provide token issuers with a legal safe harbor, which would be one of the most important U.S. regulatory developments in recent months. If implemented, it could reshape how new tokens are launched and marketed.

items.title: Coinbase secures Abu Dhabi license for tokenized securities custody
items.summary: A major development reported in the crypto roundup said Coinbase obtained a new Abu Dhabi license to custody tokenized securities. The approval would expand Coinbase’s institutional footprint in the Middle East.

items.title: MoneyGram launches cash-to-crypto ramps across 170 countries on Solana
items.summary: MoneyGram reportedly switched on cash-to-crypto conversion services across 170 countries using Solana infrastructure. The rollout is a notable real-world payments and adoption milestone for the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: Fidelity plans Ethereum staking for its $898M FETH fund
items.summary: Crypto.news reported that Fidelity is planning Ethereum staking for its $898 million FETH fund. The move would deepen institutional participation in Ethereum’s yield-bearing ecosystem.

items.title: Bank of England tests Polygon consortium for digital pound trade finance
items.summary: Crypto.news said the Bank of England tapped a Polygon consortium for digital pound trade finance tests. The project suggests continued central bank experimentation with blockchain-based settlement and trade workflows.

items.title: XRP bridge exploit investigation expands after flaw alert
items.summary: Crypto.news reported an update on an XRP bridge exploit in which a transaction identified a flaw and an FBI alert was triggered. The incident underscores ongoing cross-chain and bridge security risks in crypto infrastructure.

items.title: Litecoin’s MWEB privacy feature reaches record locked supply
items.summary: Coinpedia reported that the amount of LTC locked in Litecoin’s MimbleWimble Extension Block reached a new all-time high of 505,481.59 LTC. The milestone highlights renewed interest in Litecoin’s privacy-focused upgrade.

items.title: Pi Network token outperforms the broader crypto market
items.summary: Coinpedia said Pi crypto gained 3.19% over the past 24 hours to around $0.0859, outperforming the wider market. The move stood out amid mostly cautious price action across major assets.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
items.summary: OpenAI released a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app for Linux in preview, expanding access to Work, Codex, and related features. The app does not support Computer Use outside the in-app browser.

items.title: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard
items.summary: Nvidia announced Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, an open 30B-parameter MoE model, along with NeMo Switchyard, an open-source model routing library for AI agents. The release highlights continued movement toward more modular and agentic AI infrastructure.

items.title: Google says Gemini has surpassed 1 billion monthly users
items.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai said Gemini has reached more than 1 billion monthly active users, making it the company’s fastest-growing product ever. The milestone comes after a recent reorganization of Google’s AI division.

items.title: Meta launches Muse Glimmer as it doubles down on open AI models
items.summary: Meta reportedly launched Muse Glimmer, a new AI model release that underscores its push toward open-weight systems. The move fits a broader industry trend of major labs shipping more openly accessible models.

items.title: River AI raises $1.1 billion to build personal AI agents and local servers
items.summary: River AI, founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, secured $1.1 billion in funding from General Catalyst. The startup says it will build home and SMB servers designed to run AI locally.

items.title: Nvidia and major financial firms plan over $500 billion for AI infrastructure
items.summary: Nvidia has reportedly partnered with six major asset managers and banks to create financing platforms for AI infrastructure, with ambitions to mobilize more than $500 billion in third-party capital. The development shows continued investor enthusiasm for data centers and compute capacity.

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT with GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly rolled out a revised GPT-5.6 Sol for Plus and Pro users, while free users received GPT-5.6 Luna as the default model with unlimited text chats. The update reflects ongoing product segmentation across paid and free tiers.

items.title: Xiaomi open-sources Xiaomi-Robotics-1 foundation model
items.summary: Xiaomi reportedly released Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a robotics foundation model that maps camera input and spoken instructions to physical motion. The launch adds to a growing wave of open-source robotics and embodied AI work.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: EA completes $55 billion take-private deal
items.summary: PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Partners have formally completed their $55 billion acquisition of Electronic Arts, making the publisher a private company. Andrew Wilson remains chairman and CEO.

items.title: Supermassive Games to lay off up to 75 staff
items.summary: The Dark Pictures Anthology studio said it is cutting up to 75 jobs as part of a restructuring effort aimed at long-term sustainability.

items.title: Valve warns European Steam hardware customers of likely data compromise
items.summary: Valve said customers in Europe whose Steam hardware was shipped by CEVA Logistics were likely affected by a cyberattack on the logistics provider. The company is notifying users about the incident.

items.title: Hello Games marks No Man’s Sky’s 10th anniversary
items.summary: Sean Murray thanked players on the game’s 10th anniversary and noted that players have still discovered less than 1% of the planets in No Man’s Sky.

items.title: Knytt gets free 20th-anniversary release
items.summary: Classic indie platformer Knytt has received a 20th-anniversary version for modern PCs, and the new edition is available for free on Steam.

items.title: Rocket League main event begins at Esports World Cup 2026
items.summary: The Esports World Cup 2026 Rocket League main event starts today, with opening fixtures now set for the competition.

items.title: Nexon launches Blizzard’s Overwatch in Korea
items.summary: Nexon launched Blizzard’s Overwatch in Korea on August 12, marking a notable regional publishing and service development for the shooter.

items.title: Genshin Impact new region arrives
items.summary: A Korean gaming roundup says Genshin Impact’s new region, Snezhnaya, is being highlighted among the day’s major releases and updates.

items.title: Remedy says Alan Wake 2 has surpassed 3 million copies sold
items.summary: Remedy’s half-year financial report says Alan Wake 2 has sold more than 3 million copies and has now recouped development costs.
